Assistant (1.0s): Hello, this is the digital assistant of Freya Bank. This call is recorded. Am I speaking with Ms Schmidt?

User (2.0s): Yes, this is Hannah Schmidt.

Assistant (2.8s): Thank you. Before we continue, I need to ask you two short security questions. What is your date of birth?

User (3.8s): Twenty-eighth of April nineteen ninety-three.

Assistant (6.2s): Thank you. What is the last four digits of the phone number on file?

User (7.7s): Three three one seven.

Assistant (10.4s): Thank you, your identity is confirmed. I am calling from the Freya Bank collections team about a late payment. your credit card ending 5512 has a past-due amount of 180.00, which is 5 days late. Can you make this payment today?

User (11.4s): I paid it in the app this morning.

Assistant (17.7s): Payments can take one business day to appear. Thank you for your time, goodbye.
